name: SEED, MPS-16 ver FM1
author: Brent Walker (BeatSmith)
tagline: SEED, an MPS-16 function for the M-VAVE FM-1: chords and progressions from any notes you play
description: SEED, the chord builder of MPS-16 in the Earth Science family. Play a few notes you like, pick a scale that fits, and the 16 white keys hold its chords and progressions; the black keys play the notes of the key and light up the bass of each chord; BASS, NO BASS, NO ROOT and TAP on the last four; edit (the whole group, or hold a key for one), lock, undo, record, save, and MIDI out over USB and Bluetooth with clock. COACH walks you through it with the keys and buttons it means lit. Early development.
credits: Built on fm1-base by Charles Vestal and felucca-bsp by Leo Kuroshita.
